title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to add Filter by item attributes to the Item Ledger Entries page
summary: This post explains how to extend the Item Ledger Entries page to include filtering by item attributes, a feature already available on the Item List page. The customization adds an Item Attributes FactBox and actions to filter and clear attribute-based filters.
key_points: Item attributes allow items to be characterized by properties like height and model year for searching and customer service
The standard Item List page includes a Filter by Attributes action that uses item attribute values to build a filter for matching item numbers
The same logic can be ported to Item Ledger Entries via a page extension that adds the FilterByAttributes and ClearAttributes actions
The customization uses temporary buffers and the Item Attribute Management codeunit to find matching items and apply filters

quotes.text: Can we also add the Filter by item attributes feature to other pages like Item Ledger Entries?
quotes.why_it_matters: Frames the core question the post addresses about extending attributes filtering beyond the Item List
